subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers keep this broad production field report open as a routing umbrella, or split the remaining current-main slices into focused canonical issues and close this umbrella?
rationale: The remaining work spans config recovery policy, missed-inbound catch-up, cron ergonomics, web-search/tool policy, onboarding UX, resource policy, and update behavior; source inspection can show which slices remain, but it cannot choose the repository tracking shape or product defaults.

options.title: Split Then Close Umbrella
options.body: Keep the open config and missed-inbound issues canonical, open only focused follow-ups for current-main slices that still matter, and close this umbrella once the links are in place.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open until every slice is fixed or rejected, accepting weaker automation signal because it spans several owners and product decisions.

options.title: Close As Partially Superseded
options.body: Close now with links to narrower open issues and ask reporters to file any remaining slice that still reproduces on current main.

recommendation.title: Split Then Close Umbrella
recommendation.body: Keep the open config and missed-inbound issues canonical, open only focused follow-ups for current-main slices that still matter, and close this umbrella once the links are in place.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available routing owner from the sampled history because the strongest remaining slices involve gateway/config startup and channel runtime surfaces with recent vincentkoc-adjacent history.
